title: Single-stage NV2A register-combiner: input mapping × output scale grid
purpose: Render a 4-col × 4-row grid of 16 cells where each cell exercises one (input mapping × output scale modifier) combination of the NV2A register-combiner stage 0. Per cell: fixed DIFFUSE = (0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0); A = map(DIFFUSE), B = 1, C = 0, D = 0; SUM = AB + CD = mapped(DIFFUSE); SUM_DST = R0; R0 = clamp(scale(SUM), -1, 1); final combiner D = R0 -> fragColor.rgb = clamp(R0, 0, 1). Columns: UNSIGNED_IDENTITY / UNSIGNED_INVERT / EXPAND_NORMAL / EXPAND_NEGATE. Rows: IDENTITY / SHIFTLEFT_1 / SHIFTLEFT_2 / NOSHIFT_BIAS. Math-derived expected pixel per cell uses each DIFFUSE channel as an independent input: 0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75 -> 64 / 128 / 191 after raw 8-bit quantization at IDENTITY scale; clamps to {0, 255} for the SHIFTLEFT and BIAS rows where the magnitude pushes the result outside [0, 1]. Catches wrong A_MAP, wrong scale OP, sign-flip on EXPAND_NORMAL vs EXPAND_NEGATE, and final D_SOURCE pointing somewhere other than R0. Does NOT exercise the MUX path (MUX_ENABLE = 0 on every cell -- covered by second-wave `combiner-mux`) or the [-1, 1] stage clamp (no stage 1 reads R0 -- covered by second-wave `combiner-multi-stage`). Skipped from the §D catalog (deferred to second-wave coverage XBEs): HALFBIAS / SIGNED mappings, SHIFTLEFT_1_BIAS / SHIFTRIGHT_1 scales, DOT_PRODUCT operations, BLUE_TO_ALPHA flags, alpha-combiner-only path, C0/C1 per-stage constants, multi-stage chaining, and final-combiner E*F / SPECLIT / EF_PROD / COMPLEMENT corners.
